data_infos.name_cn: 數位發展調查年齡別網路與電腦使用率
data_infos.dataset_description: Annual digital access survey rates by source-defined age bands, with New Taipei's total personal internet-use rate.
data_infos.etl_description: Download the official CP950 CSV with a browser User-Agent, resolve columns by semantic header roles, parse source age-band changes by ROC year, and reconcile every numeric source cell that is emitted. Rates are never population-scaled into an 18-35 estimate.
